name: rsi_connors_pullback_v50
mechanism: On NIFTY and BANKNIFTY, sharp 30-60 second micro-selloffs within the prevailing intraday VWAP-trend attract delta-hedging buy flow from option market makers and VWAP-benchmarked institutional algos who are getting fills significantly better than their benchmark. When 1-minute RSI (12 bars at 5s) drops below 20 while spot trades above session VWAP, the selling is counter to the dominant directional order flow — resting bid orders at VWAP-anchored levels absorb the downtick and the index reverts within 30-90 seconds as TWAP algos resume accumulation. The symmetric short fires when RSI(12) spikes above 80 below VWAP as momentum exhaustion invites sell-side VWAP programs to press the move.
core_signal_oneliner: 1-minute RSI drops below 20 above session VWAP, attracting VWAP-benchmarked buy flow to absorb the micro-selloff
